::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 4th 1885  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: Ms. Eng. lett. e.116 ff 182-3
:::

Dear [Mr Tyrwhitt](people/person_1428.qmd)

The copy right is yours. It always stays with authors in the [Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd), so neither [Mr Smith](people/person_1344.qmd) nor I can have any objection to [Natural Beauty](other_books/otherbook_985.qmd) appearing in America[^1]

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: No serial or volume publication in America of Tyrwhitt's *The Natural Theology of Natural Beauty* (1882) (originally published in *MP* (January, April 1881) as 'The Argument from Natural Beauty') has been traced.
